messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: How large file can I upload to glimmer?
parts:
We don't have any predefined limits right now--go ahead. If you have trouble uploading such a large file through RStudio Server, you could try scp or sftp instead (although I would be curious to hear whether it succeeds with RStudio Server or not).

We will need to have some limits in the future, but you should be safe for a while.
